mapper.select: select id , warning_grade as warningGrade from tb_early_warning where node_id =#{stackId} and is_affirm = 2 and node_id is null;
select setting_value from tb_general_setting where setting_key = #{settingKey} order by id
select node_id,warning_grade from tb_general_setting where is_affirm = 0 order by warning_grade desc;

SELECT t.area_id AS areaId, t.stack_id AS stackId, t.is_affirm AS affirm, substring_index(group_concat(t.warning_grade),',',1) AS warningGrade, substring_index(group_concat(t.node_type),',',1) AS nodeType, substring_index(group_concat(t.warning_time),',',1) AS warningTime FROM( SELECT * FROM tb_early_warning WHERE warning_type in ('01','02','03') ) t INNER JOIN (SELECT area_id,MAX(warning_grade) AS warning_grade,stack_id FROM tb_early_warning where warning_type in ('01','02','03') and principal_name = #{earlyWarningDto.principalName} and warning_time >= #{earlyWarningDto.startTime} and warning_time <= #{earlyWarningDto.endTime} GROUP BY is_affirm,area_id,stack_id) t2 ON t.warning_grade = t2.warning_grade AND (t2.stack_id = t.stack_id OR t2.area_id = t.area_id) GROUP BY t.is_affirm,t.area_id,t.stack_id ORDER BY t.is_affirm DESC,group_concat(t.warning_grade) DESC

SELECT substring_index(group_concat(t.id),',',1) AS id, t.stack_id AS stackId, t.is_affirm AS affirm, substring_index(group_concat(t.warning_grade),',',1) AS warningGrade, substring_index(group_concat(t.node_type),',',1) AS nodeType, substring_index(group_concat(t.warning_val),',',1) AS warningVal, substring_index(group_concat(t.warning_time),',',1) AS warningTime FROM( SELECT * FROM tb_early_warning WHERE warning_type = #{earlyWarningDto.warningType}) t INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(warning_grade) AS warning_grade,stack_id FROM tb_early_warning where warning_type = #{earlyWarningDto.warningType} and principal_name = #{earlyWarningDto.principalName} and warning_time >= #{earlyWarningDto.startTime} and warning_time <= #{earlyWarningDto.endTime} GROUP BY is_affirm,stack_id) t2 ON t.warning_grade = t2.warning_grade AND t2.stack_id = t.stack_id GROUP BY t.is_affirm,t.stack_id ORDER BY t.is_affirm DESC,group_concat(t.warning_grade) DESC

SELECT substring_index(group_concat(t.id),',',1) AS id, t.area_id AS areaId, t.is_affirm AS affirm, substring_index(group_concat(t.warning_grade),',',1) AS warningGrade, substring_index(group_concat(t.node_type),',',1) AS nodeType, substring_index(group_concat(t.warning_val),',',1) AS warningVal, substring_index(group_concat(t.warning_time),',',1) AS warningTime FROM( SELECT * FROM tb_early_warning WHERE warning_type = #{earlyWarningDto.warningType}) t INNER JOIN (SELECT area_id,MAX(warning_grade) AS warning_grade FROM tb_early_warning where warning_type = #{earlyWarningDto.warningType} and principal_name = #{earlyWarningDto.principalName} and warning_time >= #{earlyWarningDto.startTime} and warning_time <= #{earlyWarningDto.endTime} GROUP BY is_affirm,area_id) t2 ON t.warning_grade = t2.warning_grade AND t2.area_id = t.area_id GROUP BY t.is_affirm,t.area_id ORDER BY t.is_affirm DESC,group_concat(t.warning_grade) DESC

SELECT id as id, warning_val as warningVal FROM tb_early_warning WHERE (warning_time) IN (SELECT MAX(warning_time) FROM tb_early_warning WHERE warning_type = #{warningType} AND is_affirm = #{affirm} and stack_id = #{stackId})

SELECT id as id, warning_val as warningVal FROM tb_early_warning WHERE (warning_time) IN (SELECT MAX(warning_time) FROM tb_early_warning WHERE warning_type = #{warningType} AND is_affirm = #{affirm} and area_id = #{areaId} GROUP BY node_id)
select count(*) from tb_early_warning where node_id = #{nodeId} and is_affirm = 2 and warning_type = #{warningType}

mapper.update: update tb_early_warning set warning_grade = #{earlyWarning.warningGrade}, warning_val_two = #{earlyWarning.warningValTwo},warning_val = #{earlyWarning.warningValTwo}, warning_val_three = #{earlyWarning.warningValThree},warning_val = #{earlyWarning.warningValThree}, warning_time_two = sysdate(),warning_time = sysdate() warning_time_three = sysdate(),warning_time = sysdate() where id = #{earlyWarning.id}

SELECT node_id as nodeId,warning_type as warningType,warning_val as warningVal,warning_grade AS warningGrade,node_type as nodeType FROM tb_early_warning WHERE id IN (SELECT MAX(id) FROM tb_early_warning WHERE is_affirm = '2' and stack_id = #{stackId} and warning_type not in ('01','02','03') GROUP BY warning_type,node_id) ORDER BY warning_type,warning_grade
SELECT area_id from tb_early_warning where is_affirm = '2' and area_id is not null group by area_id order by area_id

SELECT node_id as nodeId,warning_type as warningType,warning_val as warningVal,warning_grade AS warningGrade,node_type as nodeType FROM tb_early_warning WHERE id IN (SELECT MAX(id) FROM tb_early_warning WHERE is_affirm = '2' and area_id = #{areaId} and warning_type not in ('01','02','03') GROUP BY warning_type,node_id) ORDER BY warning_type,warning_grade

SELECT node_id as nodeId,warning_type as warningType,warning_val as warningVal,warning_grade AS warningGrade,node_type as nodeType FROM tb_early_warning WHERE id IN (SELECT MAX(id) FROM tb_early_warning WHERE is_affirm = '2' and stack_id = #{stackId} and warning_type not in ('01','02','03') and warning_grade = '3' GROUP BY node_id) ORDER BY warning_type,warning_grade
